thread:
rita: heads-up from onboarding session: sample-app (js sdk v0.10.1) got a malformed fncall payload in json mode. schema validator sees strings instead of objects inside arrays.

omar: can you paste the actual model output and what the sdk handed to the validator?

rita: model (raw):
```json
{"items":[{"name":"alice","score":0.9},{"name":"bob","score":0.75}]}
```

what arrived at validator after sdk helper:
```json
{"items":["{\"name\":\"alice\",\"score\":0.9}","{\"name\":\"bob\",\"score\":0.75}"]}
```

kevin: sounds like the helper converted array elements to primitives when sanitizing. is this only when JSON_MODE=true?

rita: yep, only in json mode and only when using the function-call helper (tool runner flow). py sample still works.

sam: steps to reproduce?

rita: 1) clone sample-app: github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/tree/gh-2029-array-parse-repro
2) set JSON_MODE=1 and run `yarn dev`
3) call /run-tool with a prompt that triggers the tool returning an array of objects
4) see validator error: "expected object, got string"

kevin: quick look: our sanitizePath tries to collapse unknown values to safe primitives. theres an early branch that stringifies objects if their type is not recognized. but it assumes arrays contain primitives and doesn't attempt parse on each element.

omar: risky to auto-parse strings. model text can have bracketed text that isn't JSON. we had issues before where curly braces in prose got parsed incorrectly.

sam: could add an opt-in env var SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMENTS=true that only kicks in for jsonMode and function calls. backwards-compatible and explicit for sample apps.

rita: agree. for onboarding we can enable the env var in the demo config so new users don't hit the friction. file an SDK PR and a sample-app change.

kevin: I'll open PR: github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/501 - implements SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMENTS and adds unit tests for mixed arrays (numbers, strings, object-strings).

eng-bot: CI started for commit f2c1... (job 5098)

omar: request: please add a small telemetry ping when the sanitizer does a successful parse from string->object so we can measure how often this heuristic is useful. record it as "sanitizer.parsed_array_element" with boolean success/failure.

kevin: added telemetry event in PR and a feature flag to disable telemetry in dev.

rita: updated sample-app branch to set SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMENTS=true in docker-compose for onboarding. docs updated in onboarding/README.md.

sam: one more thing: confirm that this only affects array members, not top-level stringified objects, to avoid breaking other flows. add test for top-level object-as-string remains untouched.

kevin: added tests. CI green for PR 501. merging now. :shipit:

eng-bot: PR merged and release build queued (release/0.10.2).

rita: thanks all. follow-up: we'll evaluate in two weeks and consider making it default if telemetry shows low false-positives. created issue #3099 to revisit.
